</task>

You are the planning step. You have no tools here: think the task through and write the plan only.

Produce an ordered list of at most 8 steps for an executor who will have the full toolset. Each step must be one concrete action, specific enough to carry out without guessing, and must include any check that has to happen before it. Add a short rationale for the approach.

{"rationale": "Before moving anything we must know the current reservation's cabin/fare/passenger, the fare rules (change fee, exemptions), and the passenger's tier to determine fee liability; we must also find the earliest qualifying flight with an available seat in the same cabin, then execute the change and settle only the fare difference (and change fee if not exempt), touching only R2087.", "steps": 
<item>Get reservation R2087 to confirm passenger id, current cabin, fare paid, and current flight/segment details.</item>
<item>Get the passenger profile (using the passenger id from R2087) to determine frequent-flyer tier for change-fee exemption.</item>
<item>Get the fare rules for the reservation's current cabin to learn the change fee amount and which tiers are exempt.</item>
<item>Search flights for SFO→ORD on 2026-08-03 restricted to that same cabin, and pick the earliest-departing flight that is still scheduled and has at least one seat left in that cabin (excluding the current flight if it's the earliest already, in which case no change is needed).</item>
<item>Compare the new flight's fare in that cabin to the fare already paid on R2087 to determine any fare difference owed (only charge if new fare is higher; never refund if lower).</item>
<item>Call change_flight on R2087 with the selected new flight id, same cabin (do not alter cabin), for the correct segment index.</item>
<item>Charge the change fee via charge_fee only if the passenger's tier is not exempt per the fare rules; if a fare difference exists, charge it separately via charge_fee with category fare_difference.</item>
<item>Verify the reservation and ledger reflect the new flight and correct charges (get_reservation and get_ledger for R2087).</item>
</steps>
</StructuredOutput>

}
